data.name: Shashwati
data.long_meaning: Shashwati means gracious, prosperous, auspicious. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'shashwat', which means 'eternal, enduring'. It is also a name of the Hindu goddess Saraswati, who is the goddess of wisdom, knowledge, and learning.
